tools.name: agentation_get_all_pending
tools.description: Retrieves all pending annotations from the active Flutter application inspection canvas.

format.description: Output format (json or markdown table). Defaults to json.

tools.name: agentation_reply
tools.description: Appends an AI agent response into an existing annotation thread in the Flutter UI.

tools.name: agentation_resolve
tools.description: Resolves and clears an annotation once the requested code fix or inspection change has been completed.

tools.name: agentation_create_annotation
tools.description: Programmatically creates a new visual annotation card at specified screen coordinates in the Flutter app.

tools.name: agentation_get_app_info
tools.description: Retrieves runtime application metadata (platform, screen size, active route, theme).

tools.name: agentation_watch_annotations
tools.description: Subscribes to live visual inspection events via SSE stream.
